risk: False positives: retained customers flagged as likely to churn
mitigation: Human review; respectful optional outreach; monitor precision and complaints
trigger_or_rollback: Pause if complaints rise or false-positive rate exceeds a pre-agreed threshold

risk: False negatives: customers who churn are missed
mitigation: Keep normal support channels; monitor recall; review missed cases
trigger_or_rollback: Reassess if recall falls below an agreed minimum on adequate validation data

impact: Unequal quality or burden across customer groups
likelihood: High uncertainty: only 12 rows, sampling undocumented
mitigation: Collect documented representative data; evaluate subgroup errors where lawful and adequately sized
trigger_or_rollback: Do not pilot without sufficient data and an approved fairness review

risk: Target leakage or ambiguous churn label
impact: Inflated evaluation results and invalid predictions
likelihood: Unknown; feature timing and label definition undocumented
mitigation: Define churn window; verify timestamps; exclude post-outcome information
trigger_or_rollback: Stop evaluation if feature timestamps or labels cannot be verified

impact: Unauthorized processing or exposure of customer data
mitigation: Confirm lawful basis, consent/license, access controls, retention, and data minimization
trigger_or_rollback: Do not use real customer data until permissions and controls are documented

risk: Misuse of score for punitive pricing or service denial
mitigation: Written use restrictions; score can only support optional support outreach; human review
trigger_or_rollback: Immediate suspension if used for prohibited consequential decisions

risk: Overfitting / poor generalization due to tiny dataset
mitigation: No deployment; obtain larger time-stamped dataset; evaluate on later holdout data
trigger_or_rollback: No deployment approval based on this 12-row dataset

risk: Distribution or label drift after launch
mitigation: If ever piloted, monitor feature/label drift, performance, and complaints; define review cadence
trigger_or_rollback: Roll back to documented non-ML fallback when agreed limits are breached
